title: Commit flex crediting and rollover structure for enterprise renewals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Proposal for a flexible commit crediting and rollover model aimed at increasing renewal retention and smoothing revenue recognition for mid-to-large enterprise customers. The model combines: 1) a tiered commit band structure with explicit uplift rules for expansion; 2) a credit rollover window (6-12 months) to reduce churn caused by usage seasonality; 3) a playbook for handling true-ups at renewal that preserves NRR while simplifying contract negotiations. The proposal also coordinates with the enterprise security questionnaire process to ensure rollovers and crediting are reflected in SOWs and procurement documents.
acceptance_criteria: Define 3 commit bands (Standard, Growth, Enterprise) with clear uplift percentages and pricing multipliers
Rollover policy drafted: window length, max % of unused credits eligible for rollover, and expiration rules
Experiment plan with success metrics defined (NRR lift, renewal rate delta, average deal time) and customer cohorts selected
Legal and GRC sign-off on security questionnaire language templates referencing crediting and rollover
Pilot with 8 enterprise customers executed and results documented in dashboard and postmortem

notes: Trade-off: longer rollover windows improve customer satisfaction but increase deferred revenue accounting complexity
Trade-off: generous uplift percentages speed expansion but risk cannibalizing Dedicated sales if pricing not aligned
Operational cost: Sales will need updated playbooks and template SOWs; CS to be trained on credit reconciliation workflow
